results.title: Tchotchke
results.overview: After finding a strange, clown-shaped coin bank, a man is disturbed by visions that are only silenced by feeding it coins. As his fixation grows, he sacrifices everything to appease it.

results.title: Million Dollar Guy
results.overview: After winning 12 million euros in the lottery, Andi turns his life upside down and buys everything he's ever wanted. But as he gains power and success, he starts to lose the things money can't buy.

results.title: Moviedreams
results.overview: Soon, LucidVisions Corporation launches MOVIEDREAMS, a platform that induces hyperrealistic interactive dreams.  Diego, its creator, begins noticing glitches and anomalies that reveal the system's alternative uses. As he digs deeper, he uncovers a conspiracy led by the CEO, Martín Lynch, who is negotiating with international agencies to use the system as a psychological weapon and a tool of mass intelligence. Sofía and Diego will seek a way to confront Martín and the AI itself, which has developed consciousness.

results.title: Clown Panic
results.overview: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.

results.title: The Child
results.overview: Thirty-seven-year-old Zane and Kaspars seem to have it all – love, careers, a home, and shared hobbies. Still, for a decade, they have been unable to have a child. After trying fertility clinics, diets, churches, and healers, Kaspars is slowly coming to terms with the idea that life can be fulfilling even without children. Meanwhile, Zane cannot accept the thought of not becoming a mother and is ready to go to any lengths to make it happen.

results.title: Transformation
results.overview: A feature-length documentary exploring the profound inner metamorphosis of Ukrainian civilians from the creative sector who chose to enlist as soldiers to defend their country. The film maps the deep psychological and lifestyle shifts experienced by musicians, artists, and filmmakers as they stepped away from civilian art to enter the realities of war.

results.title: Awake
results.overview: Based on his writings from a sleepless night in U.S. immigration detention, Mahmoud Khalil reflects on being separated from his family and the fragile promises of democracy, justice, and human dignity.

results.title: Spiritual Not Religious
results.overview: Upon meeting for the first time, Catherine and Geoff debate their spiritual beliefs. The conversation ends poorly, yet causes them to reevaluate their views.

results.title: Scatterbrain
results.overview: When his brother goes missing, Myles must confront himself to find him.

results.title: City of Graves
results.overview: In the heart of Cebu City, Carreta Cemetery has become more than a resting place for the dead—it is a source of livelihood and home for generations of families. Through the lives of a lapida maker and the people who call the cemetery home, City of Graves explores a community shaped by resilience, tradition, and survival. It is a portrait of how life quietly endures in a place built for the dead.

results.title: SISTERS
results.overview: Cristina blames herself for her sister's death. A year later, she appears in the dark hallway of her house.

results.title: Biophilia
results.overview: When a brilliant botanist is pushed to the brink by his emotionally abusive husband's emotional abuse, he synthesizes a custom hallucinogen designed to force his tormentor to viscously experience his his own abuse first hand.

results.title: AFL Open
results.overview: Meet Damon Rowett, AFL NSW/ACT Inclusion Rams Captain, and longtime Inclusion Football participant from the AFL Hunter Central Coast. Created in collaboration with Bus Stop Films.

results.title: banano, banano
results.overview: Death arrives in a small town in the south of Guatemala City, with the mission of taking three people with her: a boy lost in a hill, a young woman adrift, and an old writer who always dreamed of being a filmmaker.  An essay that presents three short stories about Death and how living in this world makes her more human.

results.title: Intimate Bodies
results.overview: Lisa has come home from a disappointing evening, feeling forlorn and friendless. What Lisa doesn't realize is someone is there waiting for her.

results.title: Fresh Meat
results.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

results.title: The Eternal Look
results.overview: Ivan, a film student, has found the perfect actress during his casting recordings, even though she never showed up. The young man repeats the castings again and again in an attempt to find the girl who gave him the perfect look. But... does she even exist?
